1704-5195-5362-7063.notablePrerequisites: This combo has a chance of failure based on the amount of starting mana you have and your first few coin flips. It may take significantly more or less mana than the amount shown. See the widget below for calculations.
1704-5195-5362-7063.description:
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, targeting Krark.
When you cast Quantum Misalignment, Krark, any additional copies of Krark, and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color..
Resolve a Krark trigger, flipping a coin and returning the Quantum Misalignment card to your hand if you lose and copying it if you win.
If you copy Quantum Misalignment, Storm-Kiln Artist triggers again, causing you to repeat steps 3 to 4.
Repeat steps 5—6 for each Krark trigger.
If Quantum Misalignment is back in your hand, repeat from step 1.
If you won every flip, instead resolve the Quantum Misalignment card itself, creating one more Krark token and putting the card into your graveyard.
Repeat steps 1 through 9 with Ember Island Production, if you still need more Krark copies.
If you manage to pass a critical threshold of Krark copies before both Quantum Misalignment and Ember Island Production end up in your graveyard, this combo is overwhelmingly likely to be an infinite loop from that point on. See the widget below for failure chances.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite copies of Krark, you can repeat this loop with any instant or sorcery you can cast.

339-677-7272-7296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-7272-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3967-5254-5902.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3967-5254-5902.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, Repeat.

2018-3216-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Suncleanser.
When Suncleanser dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Suncleanser from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Suncleanser enters the battlefield, it triggers, removing the flying counter from Suncleanser.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2459-3899-4053-6989.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Rograkh.
Cast Rograkh from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Moonlit Lamenter.
When Moonlit Lamenter dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

62-833-3827-3861.notablePrerequisites:
Soul of Windgrace can attack without taking damage.
Savage Ventmaw can attack without taking damage.
62-833-3827-3861.description:
Declare Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace as attackers.
When they attack, Savage Ventmaw and Soul of Windgrace trigger.
Resolve the Savage Ventmaw trigger, adding six mana that you will not lose this turn as steps and phases end.
Resolve the Soul of Windgrace trigger, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
In your next main phase, cast Waves of Aggression from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {3}{R/W}{R/W} and discarding Orzhov Basilica, causing you to untap all creatures that attacked this turn, and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

824-2728-3967-6854.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-3967-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-3967-6854.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 4.

3249-5147-5173-5334.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

470-2661-4050-7635.notablePrerequisites: The total power of creatures you control is at least 10 plus Ghalta's commander tax.
470-2661-4050-7635.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Ghalta from the command zone by paying {G}{G}.
Gwenna and Ascendant Packleader trigger.
Resolve the Gwenna trigger, untapping it and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Ascendant Packleader trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Ghalta. Then, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ghalta.
Choose to return Ghalta to the command zone from your graveyard.
Repeat.

When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Renata
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2263-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
2263-3967-6972.notes: If Geralf's Mindcrusher starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

1722-2034-4893-6705-7365.description:
Activate Katara by paying at most {4} due to Training Grounds, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create two creature tokens.
Activate Katara by paying at most {2} and tapping the creature tokens.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Katara ability, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1722-2034-4893-6705-7365.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you tap combo pieces or other applicable permanents while activating Katara's waterbend ability the first iteration. As the combo will net {C} each iteration, you can forego sacrificing and/or tapping both tokens on some loops.

2034-3470-6664-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Lotus Cobra triggers, adding {G}.
Repeat.

3490-4289-6968-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4289-6968-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

944-2816-7070.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Umbral Mantle ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

104-3188-3490-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3188-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent

When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Repeat from step 2.

1661-1987-2585-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Grim Monolith by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Grim Monolith.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

884-2530-2577-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
884-2530-2577-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Ayara, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Ayara and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

570-2608-4499.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.

325-602-4067-6282.easyPrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
325-602-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Toluz trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

1170-3363-5078-6556.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

4365-4444-5742-5743.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

465-3742-4251-4875-5223.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3742-4251-4875-5223.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

277-1669-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
277-1669-5720-5721.description:
Activate Thaumatog's first ability by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland, giving Thaumatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2082-4214-5189.easyPrerequisites: Sadistic Glee attached to a creature you control.
2082-4214-5189.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2082-4214-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
When the Saproling dies, Sadistic Glee triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it is attached to.
Repeat.

215-876-3291-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least three +1/+1 counters.
215-876-3291-3771.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Karametra's Acolyte to your hand.
Cast Karametra's Acolyte by paying {G}.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.
